sheet.title: Install this app
sheet.intro: Installing keeps your offline data safe: the browser stops treating it as something it can delete.
sheet.asked: The app already asked this browser to keep your data and it said no — browsers don’t ask you, they decide, and installing is what changes that.
sheet.androidStep2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
sheet.desktopStep1: Look for the install icon in the address bar
sheet.desktopStep2: Or open the browser menu and choose “Install Ledger Flow”
sheet.fallback: Some browsers don’t offer this at all. If yours doesn’t, keep a connection when you record and nothing will be waiting here.

landing.metaTitle: Ledger Flow · See where your money actually goes
landing.metaDescription: Log an expense in three seconds, put a ceiling on the month and catch the small daily spending before it adds up. Free, bilingual, works offline.
landing.title: See where your money actually goes.
landing.lede: Log an expense in three seconds, put a ceiling on the month and catch the small daily spending that adds up before it does.
landing.trust: Works offline · English & Español · Your data stays yours
landing.whyLede: Ledger Flow is a free expense tracker and budget app for everyday personal finance. You log what you spend, it keeps your account balances right, and it shows you where your money goes — by category, by month, and against the ceiling you set.
landing.why1Body: Tap, type the amount, done. Add the category later from your review inbox: the expense already counts.
landing.why2Body: A ceiling for the month plus per-category limits, with pace and days left in plain language, not just a bar.
landing.why3Body: Log on the bus or abroad. Everything syncs when you are back online, and nothing gets duplicated.
landing.howTitle: Up and running in a minute
landing.step1Body: Pick your currency once. Email and password, nothing else.
landing.step2Body: Cash, bank or card, with today’s balance.
landing.step3Body: Then log expenses as they happen. That is the whole habit.

privacy.metaDescription: What Ledger Flow stores, why, and how you control it. Also our data processing policy under Colombia’s Ley 1581 de 2012.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Ledger Flow stores the financial records you enter so you can see them on any device. This page explains what we keep, why, and how you control it. It also serves as our data processing policy under Colombia’s Ley 1581 de 2012.
privacy.store1: Your name, email, language, time zone and currency.
privacy.store2: Accounts, categories, transactions and budgets you create, including notes and tags.
privacy.store3: Device sessions (browser type, time of sign-in) so you can review and revoke them.
privacy.whyBody: Only to run the service: showing your data back to you, keeping balances right and securing your account. We do not sell data and we do not use it for advertising.
privacy.rightsBody: You can read, correct and delete your data from Settings at any time, and withdraw your authorization by deleting your account. Deleting it keeps the records so you can reactivate later; ask us for permanent removal and we will do it within 15 business days.
privacy.processingBody: Ledger Flow is the controller of the data you enter. The purpose is exclusively to provide the service described above. You can exercise your rights of access, update, correction, deletion and revocation through Settings or by writing to the contact below; we answer within 15 business days.
privacy.contactBody: Write to <email>{address}</email> for any question about your data.

terms.metaDescription: The terms under which Ledger Flow is offered: a free personal finance tool, your account, acceptable use and availability.
terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: Ledger Flow is a free personal finance tool. By creating an account you agree to these terms.
terms.serviceBody: Ledger Flow lets you record accounts, movements, categories and budgets and see summaries of them. It is not financial advice and it does not connect to your bank.
terms.accountBody: You are responsible for keeping your password private and for what is recorded under your account. You can delete it at any time from Settings; the records are kept for a while so you can come back, and removed permanently on request.
terms.useBody: Use the service for your own personal records. Do not try to access other people’s data, disrupt the service or automate abusive traffic.
terms.availabilityBody: The service is offered free of charge and as is, without guarantee of uninterrupted availability. We may change or discontinue features; we will announce material changes in the app.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms. The date at the top tells you when. Continuing to use the service after a change means you accept it.
